// diagnostic

E0620

Imported script `{file}` has executable top-level statements

What

Imported script `{file}` has executable top-level statements

Why

Imported files provide declarations; executable code belongs in an explicit `run: fn`, so an import never gains a hidden side effect.

Fix

Move the statements into the entry file's `run: fn`, or import a declaration-only file.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0620: tests/ui/script_imported/stderr.

Error [jet.TopLevelStatementsWithoutRun]: Top-level executable statements require an explicit `run: fn`
  --> tests/ui/script_imported/run.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | print("dependency")
    | ^^^^^
 Why: Jet does not invent a runtime function for ordinary files; only `run: fn` executes code
 Fix: Move the statements into `run: fn`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0621
